Hi Alex —

I noticed Brightline just crossed a usage spike on the self-serve plan (nice!) and wanted to offer a short 20-minute walkthrough to make sure you're getting the best latency/cost mix and to show a couple of quick playbooks (prompt engineering + batching suggestions) that we surface for trial users.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 5/16, 10:00–10:20
- Wed 5/17, 11:00–11:20
- Thu 5/18, 09:30–09:50

Or grab a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min-demo

I’m including Rishi (AE) and Marissa (Solutions) on the thread — they’ll join to cover pricing and the technical checklist. Attached a short Quickstart PDF and a one-pager with sample prompts we often use for analytics ingestion (Redwood-Quickstart.pdf, sample-prompts.txt).

If there’s a particular area you want us to focus on (throughput, embeddings, security controls for PII, or cost squeeze), reply and we’ll tailor the session.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
